says: fabrika/service-id checks only ids written at Context.Service and Context.Reference calls, so the id a right passes to Rebac.Permission is never checked; Rebac.ts:182 disables the rule where the id is forwarded, and nothing checks it where the right is declared.
proof: `node oxlint-plugins/lint.ts next/packages/libfabrika/src/permissions/Rebac.test.ts` prints `oxlint: 0 blocking` while Rebac.test.ts:51 declares `Rebac.Permission<Start>()("t953/Start", ...)`, an id not in the `@kampus/libfabrika/<path>` form the rule enforces for every next/ file (.oxlintrc.json:1492); only Model.ts:30 follows the form, by hand.
cost: Every new right's id is unchecked, so two rights can share an id or drift from the package path with no lint error, and the proof's context key is only as unique as the hand-written id.
